akyk.title: The anime girl lost her bed
akyk.prompt:
You can't sleep tonight because anime girls are stuck in your head. Then you think about taking the pills, but just as you reach for them, someone knocks on your door. At first you think you heard wrong, but when the knocking comes again, you snap back to yourself. You open the door and an anime girl appears, suddenly hugging you. In shock, you jump back, and she says:
- U-um {{user}}, I lost my bed. Could I sleep with you?
That is when you remember you were about to take the pills.

endings.hap:
You get so scared of the anime girl that you try to swallow the pill without water. It gets stuck in your throat and you die.
**~THE END~**
endings.yatak:
Anime Girl:
- U-um, thank you {{user}}. I found this on the floor and thought it might help you :blush:
You gained {{xp}} XP and {{silver}} silver.
**~THE END~**

You gained {{xp}} XP and {{silver}} silver.

gank.title: Mission: Anime Girls
gank.prompt:
You leave the university entrance exam happy because the questions were easy. On the way home, you wonder what you'll do once you get back. Then you remember your promise to play Black Ops 3 Zombies with canmertgaymingtr. When you get home and press the power button on your computer, the doorbell rings, and as usual, nobody else can answer it. You open the door and see three anime girls. You can't believe your eyes, so you go wash your face. When you come back, they are still there. One of them says:
- {{user}}, we know you were going to play with canmertgamingtr, but somehow all three of us lost our computers at the same time. Could we play next to you?

choices.hayir: How can you dumb anime girls lose your computers?

endings.evet:
You invite the anime girls inside and play games with them. At night, they say they lost their beds too and want to sleep next to you. Since you're a virgin, you cannot pass up the chance. While you sleep, the anime girls quietly gather, mutilate you, and leave laughing 🤗.
**~THE END~**
endings.hayir:
You tell them to get lost, and they accept it. They come inside anyway and you all have a wild time. Later the anime girls say they may be addicted and cannot wait for next time 😉, then leave. You happily go to your computer and find a box with a note inside:
- {{user}}, I hope you liked my gift. Thank you for choosing me instead of the anime girls.
With love, canmergaymingtr
You gained {{xp}} XP and {{silver}} silver.
**~THE END~**
